title: Avengers Assemble 101
intro: [excited] Welcome to Disney Jeopardy, everybody! Tonight's lesson is Avengers 101: the heroes, the colors, the gear, and a field trip or two. [chuckles] No homework, just glory.

art.prompt: A bright hero academy classroom with a chalkboard of doodled lightning bolts, stars and shields, desks lined up in sunlight, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Who's Who
categories.intro: Let's meet the team! I'll describe a hero or a troublemaker, you give me the name. [winks] Easy peasy.

art.prompt: A long hallway lined with framed silhouettes of mysterious heroes in dramatic poses, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This horned god of mischief is Thor's adopted brother.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is Loki! He will be back. He's always back.

clues.clue: Natasha Romanoff, a master spy, fights under this code name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Black Widow! [excited] Red in her ledger, gold on this board.

clues.clue: Wanda Maximoff's spellcasting hero name.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is the Scarlet Witch! Chaos magic, wonderful hair.

clues.clue: This walking tree of very few words protects the galaxy with his friends.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Groot! [chuckles] I am Chet.

clues.clue: Shuri, T'Challa's genius little sister, later takes on this royal hero title.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Black Panther! Wakanda's brightest mind becomes its protector.

categories.title: Marvel Emoji
categories.intro: Emoji round! Decode the little pictures and name the Marvel hero. [chuckles] Thumbs up if you love emoji.

art.prompt: A giant glowing phone screen floating in a comic-book sky full of bubbles of tiny icons, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: 🕷️🧑🏙️ Name this hero from the emoji.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Spider-Man! Thwip thwip.

clues.clue: 🐜🧑🔬 Name this tiny hero.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ant-Man! [laughs] Small hero, huge heart.

clues.clue: 🦝🔫🚀 Name this furry Guardian.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Rocket! Do not call him a trash panda.

clues.clue: 🧙‍♂️🔮🩺 Name this hero, a surgeon turned sorcerer.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Doctor Strange! [chuckles] Still technically a doctor.

clues.clue: 🌙🪦🦅 Name this hero, the fist of an Egyptian moon god.
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is Moon Knight! Marc, Steven, and a very bossy bird skull.

categories.title: Costume Colors
categories.intro: Palette round! Each set of colors comes from a famous Marvel costume. Name the hero who wears it.

art.prompt: An artist paint palette with bold primary color splotches next to a sketchbook of costume designs, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which armored hero wears these colors?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Iron Man! Hot rod red and gold. Very flashy.

clues.clue: Whose big look is built from these colors?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Hulk! [laughs] Green skin, purple stretchy pants.

clues.clue: Whose sleek suit glows in these shades?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Black Panther! Black vibranium with that purple kinetic glow.

clues.clue: Which cosmic hero flies in these colors?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Captain Marvel! [excited] Red, navy, and that golden star.

clues.clue: Which tricky Asgardian struts in these colors?
clues.reveal: [dramatically] The correct answer is Loki! Green, gold and black. Mischief has a dress code.

categories.title: Hero Field Trips
categories.intro: Field trip! These heroes show up at Disney parks and ships around the world. [excited] Grab your permission slip.

art.prompt: A colorful map of the world with little glowing pins and a cruise ship sailing between continents, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Hong Kong Disneyland's first Marvel ride lets guests soar beside this armored hero.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Iron Man! The Iron Man Experience opened in 2017.

clues.clue: Hong Kong Disneyland's Nano Battle! stars Ant-Man and this winged partner.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Wasp! [excited] Tiny wings, big zap.

clues.clue: On some Disney Cruise Line sailings, heroes take over the ship for this special themed day.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Marvel Day at Sea! Heroes on deck, villains overboard.

clues.clue: Because of an old theme park deal, many Marvel heroes appear at a rival resort in this state instead of at Walt Disney World.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Florida! [chuckles] That's why Orlando's Disney heroes are mostly Guardians.

clues.clue: Disneyland's Avengers Campus tells a story that it was built on the old site of this famous hero's company.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Stark Industries! Tony's old factory became a hero campus.

categories.title: Big Screen Firsts
categories.intro: Back to the movies, where it all began. [chuckles] Popcorn ready, true believers?

art.prompt: A grand old movie palace marquee glowing at night with empty frames for posters, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: The very first movie of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, from 2008, was titled this.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Iron Man! And just like that, a universe was born.

clues.clue: In the first Avengers movie, the team battles an alien army in this big city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is New York City! [laughs] Then they all went out for shawarma.

clues.clue: Nick Fury runs this spy agency.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is S.H.I.E.L.D.! Lots of secrets, lots of periods.

clues.clue: Thor and his family come from this golden realm.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Asgard! [dramatically] Shiny palace, rainbow bridge.

clues.clue: Steve Rogers wakes up in modern times after being frozen in ice for nearly this many years.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is about seventy! Talk about a long nap.
